transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I’m here because this has been going on almost two years now. I’m sure the contractor, and some people on my block too, have been working together somehow to cheat us. The kitchen was never done right, and I feel like they’ve kept it half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they all have their excuses, but it doesn’t change what I can see is happening.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like voices when I’m alone. It’s not that.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I don’t think so. I have nights where I don’t sleep well, but I wouldn’t say I’m full of energy or needing less sleep than usual.
Even when your husband shows you receipts and explanations, do you still feel certain the contractor and neighbors are cheating you on purpose?

Yes. I still feel certain. The receipts don’t really change what I can see. It’s been nearly two years, and the kitchen is still wrong in ways that don’t feel accidental to me. I think the contractor and some people around here are quietly working together to cheat us, no matter what explanations they give.
During this period, have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I’m not sure I’d say depressed most of the day nearly every day. I’ve been upset and worn down by everything, but not depressed like that every single day.
Have other people told you that your speech or behavior has seemed very disorganized?
No, I don’t think anyone has said that to me. I mean, people may disagree with me or think I’m upset, but I haven’t been told my speech or behavior is disorganized.
Aside from this situation with the contractor and neighbors, have you had any other beliefs that other people said were not true?

No, not really aside from that. It’s mainly this kitchen and the contractor, and some people on the block being involved. That’s the thing I’m sure about, even when my husband brings me receipts or they give explanations.
Have you had any brain injury or neurological illness?
Not that I know of. I haven’t had a brain injury or anything neurological that I’m aware of.
Have you ever believed that people were sending you special messages through the television, radio, or internet?

No, not through the TV or radio or anything like that. What I’ve been dealing with is the contractor and some people on my block. I’m sure they’ve been working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose, even though my husband keeps showing me receipts and they keep making excuses.
Have there been times when you felt unusually euphoric or high?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had times where I felt especially high or euphoric like that.
Have you found yourself losing interest or motivation to do your usual activities?

No, not really. I mean, the remodel has taken up a lot of my attention, but outside of that I still go to my church gatherings, my book club, keep up with things around the house, and make plans with my family like I usually do.
Have you become noticeably less emotionally expressive than you used to?
I don’t think so. I still react to things about the same, I think. My family hasn’t said I seem flat or anything like that.
Have you ever seen things that other people said were not actually there?
No, I haven’t seen things that other people said weren’t there. Nothing like that.
Have you heard voices talking to you or about you?
No, I haven’t heard voices talking to me or about me. Nothing like that.
Is it possible that the contractor really could have kept the kitchen unfinished or incorrect on purpose to cheat you?

Yes, I think it’s possible. Honestly, I’ve been sure for almost two years that the contractor didn’t just mess up by accident. I think he and some people on my block have been quietly working together to cheat us, keeping the kitchen unfinished or done wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts and they all give excuses, but it doesn’t change what I can see.
Has this situation caused problems for you at work or in your relationships?

Yes, it has. I’m not working now, so not in that way, but it’s caused tension at home. I’ve stopped trusting certain neighbors and workers, and I keep questioning what people are really doing. My husband has had to take over more of the remodeling decisions because I get stuck on whether they’re being honest with us.

Functioning is relatively preserved outside the delusional theme, though there is relationship impairment. This is most consistent with delusional disorder, persecutory type (ICD-10 F22).
